Analyse actuals against the budget details and manage budget reallocations as needed. Summarise data weekly for the budget dashboards and process reclass entries wherever required. Manage year-end accruals to ensure effective utilization of available budget through recording and submitting to Finance accrual entries for expenses incurred through the year that are not processed during the same year. Engagement Code management: Ensure proper use of travel expenses and accurate code mapping across Global and Americas sponsoring entities. Manage cost movements across codes throughout the year. Annual fee: Track manage annual alliance fee records and process journal entries for codes received. Manage monthly recurring entries and year end accruals. GDS budget Analysis / updates: Manage and update GDS headcount file with latest rates, headcount status, new roles and hiring/exit status. Reconcile general chargeback code to regularly assess and report available balance for GDS cost management. Provide details to stakeholders on required fees to manage GDS costs. Perform headcount analysis and savings through cost arbitrage. Connect with stakeholders as required to understand the budget usage, future expected costs and accruals. Manage GDS invoice records, billing inventory, and assist in periodic invoicing activities. Review reconcile invoices and highlight any discrepancies in the GDS invoices. Reporting: Weekly budget to actuals for the charge codes assigned. Reporting monthly financials and other reports highlighting key performance parameters. Connect with GDS team on the open items, provide support on the invoicing process, offer any other finance support on the new programs / activities. Reconcile and summarise investment data for quarterly reporting and dashboard. Adhoc Analysis / Reports: Ad-hoc reporting/operations/admin support for initiatives/ projects as required. Strong operational acumen to create impactful relationships with Senior leadership. Focus on client and effectively use consultative approaches for stakeholder management. Effective in time management and project prioritization Shows high degree of professionalism and integrity. Uses outstanding speaking and writing skills to enhance understanding and encourage collaboration. Collaborative mindset with ability to identify risk or opportunity areas. Ability to think ahead of the curve and forecast outcomes to suggest appropriate solutions. Academics Graduate or post-graduate degree in commerce/finance. Job qualification 8+ years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced global environment, should be able to perform highly complex transactions in person (not by delegating) Advanced knowledge of the principles of accounting. Experience working as an accountant is preferred, alternatively experience in GL domain in BPO FA. Exposure to budget preparation and maintenance Proficient in MS Excel, exposure to MS Access and Power Bi would be an added advantage. Should be comfortable with working on large spreadsheets with multiple pages and with extensive data, should have a good eye for detail. Experience in working with Finance systems, preferably in an SAP environment. Should have good English speaking and writing skills, should be an effective communicator. Should be a fast learner and should be quick to pick up concepts and requirements. Should be able to take the lead, work independently and ensure that work is properly organized, and delivered in a timely manner, with high accuracy and quality. Experience of interacting with geographically dispersed professionals strongly preferred. Reporting experience, knowledge of standard metrics and key performance indicators Understanding of business research or data interpretation and analysis concepts Understanding of Project Management concepts and experience working on non-IT projects Professional services industry experience, or internal or external client-serving experience preferred. title: Assistant Manager - Inventory
description:
Assistant Manager - Inventory Location : Angamaly Qualification : Bachelors degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field Experience : 6+ years, preferably in inventory/warehouse management within a manufacturing or food/FMCG environment. About Bayfield Bayfield Food Ingredients Pvt. Ltd. is a fast-growing food solutions company specializing in seasonings, culinary solutions, and food ingredients for the HoReCa and institutional markets. As Bayfield scales its operations, we are looking for a hands-on Inventory Manager who will bring discipline, accuracy, and traceability to raw material, packaging, and finished goods inventory, supporting uninterrupted production and reliable order fulfilment. This position offers a strong opportunity for an inventory/warehouse operations professional to build robust systems from the ground up and grow into broader supply chain leadership as the organization expands. Purpose of the Role The Inventory Manager will be responsible for the accuracy, availability, and traceability of Bayfields inventory across raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods. The role requires a hands-on professional who enjoys building systems, tightening processes, and working closely with Procurement, Production, and QC in a fast-growing entrepreneurial environment. Working Style The Inventory Manager is expected to be a hands-on professional who enjoys working in a fast-growing business. The role requires ownership, attention to detail, and the willingness to work across functions to build robust inventory processes rather than operate within a large corporate structure. Key Responsibilities The Inventory Manager will be the custodian of Bayfields inventory accuracy and warehouse discipline, ensuring stock records, documentation, and logistics coordination are accurate, timely, and fully compliant at all times. 1. Inventory Planning Stock Management Maintain optimal stock levels of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods. Plan replenishment cycles in coordination with Procurement Strategic Sourcing and Production. Implement and monitor FIFO/FEFO practices to minimize wastage and expiry-related losses. Track slow-moving and obsolete stock, and recommend corrective action. 2. Warehouse Operations Oversee receiving, storage, put-away, and dispatch across the warehouse. Ensure proper handling and storage conditions for temperature- and humidity-sensitive ingredients. Maintain warehouse layout, safety, and hygiene standards in line with food-grade storage norms. Supervise day-to-day warehouse activities and staff task allocation. 3. Documentation Traceability Maintain accurate batch/lot traceability records for all inbound and outbound stock. Ensure inventory documentation meets QC/FSQR compliance requirements. Maintain GRNs, stock ledgers, and dispatch documentation without gaps. Support internal and external audits with timely retrieval of records. 4. Inventory Audits Reconciliation Conduct regular cycle counts and periodic full physical stock audits. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between system and physical stock. Maintain stock accuracy within the agreed threshold (target: 98%+). 5. Procurement Logistics Coordination Coordinate inward logistics with vendors, tracking shipments and resolving delays. Liaise with Procurement Strategic Sourcing on reorder points and lead times. Coordinate outward dispatch with Sales/Customer Experience teams to meet order timelines. 6. Costing Reporting Support accurate inventory valuation and stock reconciliation for Finance. Generate periodic inventory reports - stock ageing, turnover, wastage, and open orders. Present inventory MIS to the Operations Lead for management review. 7. Team Supervision Supervise warehouse staff (Warehouse Incharge, Stacker Operators, and similar roles). Allocate daily tasks and monitor team performance. Train staff on inventory processes, safety, and hygiene practices. 8. Systems Process Improvement Ensure effective utilization of inventory/ERP systems for stock tracking. Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual errors. Support digitization of inventory records where applicable. 9. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with QC/FSQR on compliance and inspection requirements. Coordinate with Production on material availability for planned batches. Support the Operations Lead with data for demand planning and forecasting. Desired Skills Strong understanding of inventory and warehouse management practices. Working knowledge of ERP/inventory management systems. Proficiency in Excel for stock reconciliation and reporting. Understanding of FIFO/FEFO and batch traceability practices, ideally in food/FMCG. High attention to detail. Strong integrity and ownership. Leadership and team supervision experience. Ability to work independently in a fast-growing entrepreneurial environment. Preferred Background Bachelors degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field. 3-5 years of experience in inventory/warehouse management. Experience in food, FMCG, or ingredients manufacturing preferred. Experience managing a small warehouse team. What Success Looks Like Within the first 6-12 months, the Inventory Manager should: Achieve stock accuracy of 98%+ between system records and physical inventory during audits. Ensure zero or near-zero stockouts of critical raw materials that disrupt production schedules. Reduce wastage from expiry/spoilage consistently, quarter over quarter. Run inward and outward logistics on schedule, with delays flagged and resolved proactively. Deliver inventory reports (ageing, turnover, open orders) on time, giving the Operations Lead a reliable picture of stock health. Maintain batch/lot traceability that holds up cleanly during QC or compliance audits. Run a warehouse team that operates safely and efficiently, with low error rates in picking, storage, and dispatch. Career Opportunity Bayfield offers a strong opportunity for an inventory/warehouse operations professional to grow with the organization. As the company scales, the role is expected to evolve into broader supply chain and operations leadership responsibilities, offering significant professional growth for the right individual.
